scope:
Targeted N240/N300,70-digit imaginary spectral QEP extension.

Imports the unchanged Referee2 Newton implementation. The sole eigenpair
seed is the stored converged N128,70-digit spectral eigenpair, padded with
zero Chebyshev coefficients. No independent Jost/Frobenius frequency or
field enters the matrix construction, initialization or Newton iteration.
The reference is loaded lazily when the unchanged post-Newton diagnostics
first access it. The solver always computes a bordered Newton correction
before checking its stopping criterion. This is a new bounded calculation,
not a rerun of an original historical Maple/Julia campaign.
method: Unchanged imaginary_multiprecision_newton.solve(); fully rebuilt 70-digit real QEP; bordered Newton for alpha=-Im(varpi) and all N Chebyshev coefficients, normalized by Phi(-0.3)=1.

seed.description: Converged N128,70-digit SPECTRAL eigenpair from the preceding precision study, converted directly to70-digit mpf arrays and zero-padded to the new N. No Jost or independent reference value in the solve.
seed.inherited_solver_seed_label_overridden: binary64 spectral candidate, no independent reference in solve

reference.role: frequency and1025-point field comparison only after Newton convergence

result.seed: Converged N128,70-digit SPECTRAL eigenpair from the preceding precision study, converted directly to70-digit mpf arrays and zero-padded to the new N. No Jost or independent reference value in the solve.

limits: Numerical residuals and cross-method differences are diagnostics, not rigorous error bounds or a completeness proof.
